title: The headline held open over its correction
body: A rubber band keeps the newspaper open, but its fold covers the correction column. The headline is still visible; the folded page has split along the correction's first sentence.
rival_reading: An office could fold an old correction out of view while updating unrelated public material; a torn column does not establish a cover-up.
gloss: A correction is hidden while its headline remains easy to read.

title: The sprayer left its outline on the page
body: The empty garden sprayer has left a clean circle on the notebook beneath it. A dried green line runs from the nozzle to a sketch of crop rows.
rival_reading: An emergency cleanup could place ordinary gardening equipment beside a route sketch; residue and a drawing do not prove a program was involved.
gloss: A sprayer and crop sketch carry the same green trace.
